The engine is dirty, with visible oil stains, grime, and some rust on components.
There are multiple hoses, belts, and pulleys attached to the engine.
A label with a barcode is visible on the left side of the engine block, but the text is not legible.
The engine appears to be a V6 or V8, based on the number of cylinders and components.
The watermark 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' is overlaid on all photos, suggesting the seller's name or business.
